About the Colony

River Green
Society

Our flagship 2024 township in Shamli — landscaped fountain plaza, wide internal roads, and a live plot-booking map. River Green Society is a premium residential plotted development located in Shamli, UP. Designed with modern infrastructure and thoughtful planning, it offers a perfect blend of urban convenience and natural serenity.

Every aspect of the colony is crafted to ensure a premium lifestyle — from wide, well-laid roads to beautiful green landscapes. With 24/7 security, underground electricity, and dedicated water supply, this is where your dream home begins.
